requirements.title: SMS on Application Rejection
requirements.description: The system shall send an SMS to the applicant on rejection of the application, including the reason for rejection.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the application is rejected by the District Social Welfare Officer, When the rejection decision is recorded in the system, Then an SMS shall be sent to the applicant's mobile number stating the rejection reason.

requirements.title: SMS on Appeal Allowance
requirements.description: The system shall send an SMS to the applicant when the appeal is allowed by the Director, Social Welfare.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the appeal is allowed by the Director, Social Welfare, When the decision is recorded in the system, Then an SMS shall be sent to the applicant's mobile number confirming the appeal is allowed.

requirements.title: SMS on Appeal Dismissal
requirements.description: The system shall send an SMS to the applicant when the appeal is dismissed by the Director, Social Welfare.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the appeal is dismissed by the Director, Social Welfare, When the decision is recorded in the system, Then an SMS shall be sent to the applicant's mobile number stating the appeal is dismissed.

requirements.title: SMS on Payment Failure Record
requirements.description: The system shall send an SMS to the applicant when a DBT payment failure is recorded in PFMS.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a DBT payment fails in PFMS, When the payment failure is recorded in the system, Then an SMS shall be sent to the applicant's mobile number notifying the payment failure.

requirements.title: Mobile Application for Students
requirements.description: The system shall provide a mobile application for students to submit and track scholarship applications.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the student accesses the scholarship scheme, When the student uses the mobile application, Then the student shall be able to submit a new application or check the status of an existing application.

requirements.title: Dashboard for Pending Applications
requirements.description: The system shall provide a dashboard to the District Social Welfare Officer showing pending applications of every institution and the duration they have been pending.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the District Social Welfare Officer accesses the dashboard, When the dashboard is loaded, Then it shall display the pending applications of every institution and the number of days each application has been pending.

requirements.title: Re-apply Opportunity on Rejection
requirements.description: The system shall allow the applicant to correct the application and re-apply once if the application is rejected.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an application is rejected by the District Social Welfare Officer, When the applicant corrects the application, Then the system shall allow the applicant to re-apply once.

requirements.title: SMS on Appeal Filing
requirements.description: The system shall send an SMS to the applicant when an appeal is filed against the rejection.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant files an appeal against the rejection, When the appeal is recorded in the system, Then an SMS shall be sent to the applicant's mobile number confirming the appeal is filed.

requirements.title: SMS on Appeal Decision
requirements.description: The system shall send an SMS to the applicant on the decision of the appeal by the Director, Social Welfare.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the Director, Social Welfare makes a decision on the appeal, When the decision is recorded in the system, Then an SMS shall be sent to the applicant's mobile number stating the decision.

requirements.title: SMS on Sanction
requirements.description: The system shall send an SMS to the applicant on sanction of the application.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the application is sanctioned by the District Social Welfare Officer, When the sanction is recorded in the system, Then an SMS shall be sent to the applicant's mobile number confirming the sanction.

requirements.title: SMS on Verification
requirements.description: The system shall send an SMS to the applicant on verification of the application by the institution nodal officer.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the application is verified by the institution nodal officer, When the verification is recorded in the system, Then an SMS shall be sent to the applicant's mobile number confirming the verification.

requirements.title: SMS on Correction Return
requirements.description: The system shall send an SMS to the applicant when the application is returned for correction by the institution nodal officer.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the application is returned for correction by the institution nodal officer, When the return is recorded in the system, Then an SMS shall be sent to the applicant's mobile number stating the correction required.

requirements.title: SMS on Application Submission
requirements.description: The system shall send an SMS to the applicant on submission of the application.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the application is submitted by the applicant, When the submission is recorded in the system, Then an SMS shall be sent to the applicant's mobile number with the application number and due date.

requirements.title: SMS on Credit Confirmation
requirements.description: The system shall send an SMS to the applicant on confirmation of credit of the scholarship amount to the bank account.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the scholarship amount is credited to the applicant's bank account, When the credit is confirmed in the system, Then an SMS shall be sent to the applicant's mobile number confirming the credit.

requirements.title: CSCs for Application Submission
requirements.description: The system shall allow CSC operators to apply on behalf of students who do not have internet access, and send the acknowledgement to the student's mobile number.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a student does not have internet access, When a CSC operator applies on behalf of the student, Then the system shall send an SMS to the student's mobile number with the acknowledgement.

requirements.title: Reuse of Verified Documents for Renewal
requirements.description: The system shall reuse documents already verified in the previous year for renewal applications and shall not require the applicant to upload them again.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a renewal application is submitted, When the system identifies documents verified in the previous year, Then the system shall reuse those documents and shall not require the applicant to upload them again.

requirements.title: Portal Language Support
requirements.description: The system shall provide the scholarship portal in Hindi and English.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant accesses the scholarship portal, When the portal is loaded, Then it shall be available in Hindi and English.

requirements.title: Low-End Android Phone Support
requirements.description: The system shall ensure the scholarship portal works on low-end Android phones on 3G connections.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant accesses the scholarship portal from a low-end Android phone on a 3G connection, When the portal is loaded, Then the portal shall function correctly without errors.

requirements.title: Grievance Resolution Notification
requirements.description: The system shall send an SMS to the applicant when the grievance is resolved within 7 working days of receipt.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a grievance is received, When the grievance is resolved within 7 working days, Then an SMS shall be sent to the applicant's mobile number confirming the resolution.

requirements.title: Monthly Report Submission
requirements.description: The system shall generate and submit a monthly report to the Principal Secretary, Social Welfare Department, showing district-wise status of applications.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the end of the month, When the monthly report is generated, Then the system shall submit the report to the Principal Secretary, Social Welfare Department, showing district-wise status of applications.

requirements.title: Status Notification at Every Stage
requirements.description: The system shall inform the applicant by SMS at every stage of processing of the application.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the application is processed at any stage, When the stage is completed, Then the system shall send an SMS to the applicant's mobile number informing the status.

requirements.title: Dashboard for District Social Welfare Officer
requirements.description: The system shall provide a dashboard to the District Social Welfare Officer showing district-wise status of applications.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the District Social Welfare Officer accesses the dashboard, When the dashboard is loaded, Then it shall show the district-wise status of applications.

requirements.title: Online Grievance Facility
requirements.description: The system shall provide an online grievance facility to applicants.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant accesses the scholarship portal, When the applicant submits a grievance, Then the system shall record the grievance and assign it a tracking number.

requirements.title: Direct Benefit Transfer to Aadhaar-Seeded Account
requirements.description: The system shall pay the scholarship through Direct Benefit Transfer using PFMS to the Aadhaar-seeded bank account of the applicant.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the application is sanctioned, When the payment is processed, Then the system shall pay the scholarship through Direct Benefit Transfer using PFMS to the Aadhaar-seeded bank account of the applicant.

requirements.title: Single Instalment Payment by 31 March
requirements.description: The system shall ensure the scholarship is paid in a single instalment not later than 31 March of the academic year.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the academic year, When the payment is processed, Then the system shall pay the scholarship in a single instalment not later than 31 March of the academic year.

requirements.title: Application Sanction within 30 Working Days
requirements.description: The system shall ensure the scholarship is sanctioned within 30 working days of submission of a complete application.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a complete application is submitted, When the application is processed, Then the system shall sanction the scholarship within 30 working days of submission.

requirements.title: Data Retention for 8 Years
requirements.description: The system shall retain applicant data for 8 years after the last payment and then anonymise it.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the last payment is made, When 8 years have passed, Then the system shall anonymise the applicant data.

requirements.title: Audit Trail for Status Changes
requirements.description: The system shall log all status changes, data edits and exports, and the audit trail shall be viewable by the State administrator.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a status change, data edit or export occurs, When the action is performed, Then the system shall log the action and the audit trail shall be viewable by the State administrator.

requirements.title: Pre-filled Renewal Application
requirements.description: The system shall provide pre-filled renewal applications to last year's beneficiaries when the renewal window opens on 1 July.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the renewal window opens on 1 July, When last year's beneficiaries access the renewal application, Then the system shall provide pre-filled renewal applications.

requirements.title: Escalation on SLA Breach
requirements.description: The system shall escalate institution delays to the District Social Welfare Officer, and DSWO delays to the Joint Director, Social Welfare.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the institution verification exceeds 15 days, When the delay is detected, Then the system shall escalate the delay to the District Social Welfare Officer; Given the DSWO sanction exceeds 15 days, When the delay is detected, Then the system shall escalate the delay to the Joint Director, Social Welfare.

requirements.title: Beneficiary Master Migration for Renewal
requirements.description: The system shall migrate only 2025-26 beneficiaries as a beneficiary master for renewal; pending paper applications are not migrated.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the system is set up for renewal, When the beneficiary master is created, Then only 2025-26 beneficiaries shall be migrated as a beneficiary master; pending paper applications shall not be migrated.

requirements.title: Caste and Income Certificate from DigiLocker
requirements.description: The system shall obtain caste and income certificates from DigiLocker where available; otherwise the applicant shall upload the certificate in the prescribed format in Annexure A.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant submits the application, When the caste and income certificates are required, Then the system shall obtain them from DigiLocker where available; otherwise the applicant shall upload the certificate in the prescribed format in Annexure A.

requirements.title: Aadhaar-based e-KYC Mandatory
requirements.description: The system shall perform Aadhaar-based e-KYC of the applicant as mandatory.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant submits the application, When the application is processed, Then the system shall perform Aadhaar-based e-KYC of the applicant as mandatory.

requirements.title: Application Submission via CSCs
requirements.description: The system shall allow applications to be submitted through Common Service Centres (CSCs).
acceptanceCriteria: Given a student does not have internet access, When the student applies through a CSC, Then the system shall accept the application submitted through the CSC.

requirements.title: Reasons for Rejection in Writing
requirements.description: The system shall record reasons in writing for every rejection and communicate them to the applicant.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the application is rejected, When the rejection is recorded in the system, Then reasons shall be recorded in writing and communicated to the applicant.

requirements.title: Renewal Attendance Certification
requirements.description: The system shall require the applicant to have attended at least 75% of classes in the previous academic year, as certified by the institution, for renewal.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a renewal application is submitted, When the system checks eligibility, Then the applicant shall have attended at least 75% of classes in the previous academic year, as certified by the institution.

requirements.title: Annual Family Income Limit
requirements.description: The system shall ensure the annual family income of the applicant does not exceed Rs. 3,00,000 per annum for eligibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant submits the application, When the system checks eligibility, Then the annual family income of the applicant shall not exceed Rs. 3,00,000 per annum.

requirements.title: Domicile Requirement
requirements.description: The system shall ensure the applicant is a domicile of Rajyapradesh.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant submits the application, When the system checks eligibility, Then the applicant shall be a domicile of Rajyapradesh.

requirements.title: Post-Matric Course in Recognised Institution
requirements.description: The system shall ensure the applicant is studying in a post-matric course in an institution recognised by the competent authority in Rajyapradesh.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant submits the application, When the system checks eligibility, Then the applicant shall be studying in a post-matric course in an institution recognised by the competent authority in Rajyapradesh.

requirements.title: Application Status Tracking
requirements.description: The system shall provide the applicant with a means to know the status of their application.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant submits the application, When the applicant checks the status, Then the system shall display the current status of the application.

requirements.title: Grievance Resolution within 7 Working Days
requirements.description: The system shall resolve grievances within 7 working days of receipt.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a grievance is received, When the grievance is resolved, Then the grievance shall be resolved within 7 working days of receipt.

requirements.title: Monthly Report to Principal Secretary
requirements.description: The system shall submit a monthly report to the Principal Secretary, Social Welfare Department.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the end of the month, When the monthly report is generated, Then the system shall submit the report to the Principal Secretary, Social Welfare Department.

requirements.title: Dashboard for DSWO Pending Applications
requirements.description: The system shall provide a dashboard to the District Social Welfare Officer showing pending applications of every institution and how long they have been pending.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the District Social Welfare Officer accesses the dashboard, When the dashboard is loaded, Then it shall show the pending applications of every institution and how long they have been pending.

requirements.title: Annual Family Income Limit of Rs. 3,00,000

requirements.title: All Other Conditions Unchanged

blocks.SOURCES:
[GO-1] (Info) The State Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme is presently administered through paper applications submitted at institutions and forwarded to District Social Welfare Offices. Applications take 6 to 9 months to be sanctioned, files are lost in transit, and students have no means of knowing the status of their application.
[GO-2] (Info) Government has decided that all applications under the scheme, fresh and renewal, shall be received, verified, sanctioned and paid online from the academic year 2026-27, so that eligible students receive the scholarship in a transparent and time-bound manner.
[GO-3.1] (Rule) The applicant shall be a domicile of Rajyapradesh.
[GO-3.3] (Rule) The applicant shall be studying in a post-matric course in an institution recognised by the competent authority in Rajyapradesh.
[GO-3.4] (Rule) For renewal, the applicant shall have attended at least 75% of classes in the previous academic year, as certified by the institution.
[GO-4.1] (Mandate) Applications shall be submitted online through the scholarship portal or through Common Service Centres (CSCs).
[GO-4.2] (Mandate) Aadhaar-based e-KYC of the applicant shall be mandatory.
[GO-4.3] (Mandate) Caste and income certificates shall be obtained from DigiLocker where available; otherwise the applicant shall upload the certificate in the prescribed format in Annexure A.
[GO-5.1] (Timeline) The nodal officer of the institution shall verify the application within 15 days of submission.
[GO-5.2] (Timeline) The District Social Welfare Officer shall sanction or reject the verified application within 15 days of receipt.
[GO-5.3] (Mandate) Reasons shall be recorded in writing for every rejection and communicated to the applicant.
[GO-6.1] (Mandate) The scholarship shall be paid through Direct Benefit Transfer using PFMS to the Aadhaar-seeded bank account of the applicant.
[GO-6.2] (Timeline) The scholarship shall be paid in a single instalment not later than 31 March of the academic year.
[GO-7.1] (Mandate) An online grievance facility shall be provided to applicants.
[GO-7.2] (Mandate) The applicant shall be informed by SMS at every stage of processing of the application.
[GO-7.3] (Timeline) Grievances shall be resolved within 7 working days of receipt.
[GO-8.1] (Mandate) A dashboard shall be provided to the District Social Welfare Officer showing district-wise status of applications.
[GO-8.2] (Mandate) A monthly report shall be submitted to the Principal Secretary, Social Welfare Department.
[GO-9] (Timeline) The scholarship shall be sanctioned within 30 working days of submission of a complete application, and the service is notified under the Rajyapradesh Right to Service Act.
[GO-10] (Mandate) Personal data collected under the scheme shall be used only for the purposes of the scheme.
[COR1-1] (Rule) In paragraph 3.2 of the G.O. read above, for "Rs. 2,50,000 (Rupees two lakh fifty thousand only)" read "Rs. 3,00,000 (Rupees three lakh only)". The annual family income limit for eligibility is accordingly Rs. 3,00,000 per annum.
[COR1-2] (Info) All other conditions of the G.O. remain unchanged.
[MIN-1] (Mandate) CSC operators shall be permitted to apply on behalf of students who do not have internet access, and the acknowledgement shall be sent to the student's mobile number.
[MIN-2] (Mandate) For renewal applications, documents already verified in the previous year shall be reused and shall not be uploaded again.
[MIN-3] (Mandate) The portal shall be available in Hindi and English.
[MIN-5] (Mandate) The portal shall work on low-end Android phones on 3G connections.
[VB-1] (Mandate) There should also be a mobile application for students, because most students have only a mobile phone.
[VB-2] (Mandate) The District Social Welfare Officer needs a dashboard showing the pending applications of every institution and how long they have been pending.
[VB-3] (Mandate) If an application is rejected, the student should be told the reason for rejection by SMS and be given one chance to correct it and apply again.

blocks.SUPERSEDED:
[GO-3.2] superseded by COR1-1: The annual income of the applicant's family from all sources shall not exceed Rs. 2,50,000 (Rupees two lakh fifty thousand only).
[MIN-4] superseded by GO-5.1: Institution verification shall be completed within 10 days of submission.
blocks.RESOLUTIONS:
[RES-1] Supersession GO-3.2, COR1-1: COR1-1 prevails.
[RES-2] Conflict GO-5.1, MIN-4: GO-5.1 prevails.
[RES-3] MissingReference GO-4.3: deferred to the department (open issue).
blocks.ANSWERS:
[ANS-1] When a DBT payment fails in PFMS (for example the account is not Aadhaar-seeded or is closed), what should happen to the application? Answer: Notify the student by SMS to correct bank details within 30 days; re-initiate in the next weekly batch
[ANS-2] Can a student appeal against rejection by the District Social Welfare Officer, and to whom? Answer: Appeal to the Director, Social Welfare within 30 days
blocks.ASSUMPTIONS:

[ASM-4] Escalation on SLA breach: Institution delays are escalated to the District Social Welfare Officer, and DSWO delays to the Joint Director, Social Welfare.
[ASM-5] Renewal: The renewal window opens on 1 July and last year's beneficiaries receive a prefilled renewal application.
[ASM-6] Data retention: Applicant data is retained for 8 years after the last payment and then anonymised.
[ASM-7] Audit: All status changes, data edits and exports are logged, and the audit trail is viewable by the State administrator.

[FR-APP-011 in Online Building Plan Approval] Assisted application with applicant consent: The system shall allow an authorised intermediary to submit an application on behalf of an applicant after recording the applicant's consent by OTP to the applicant's mobile number, and shall record the intermediary ID on the application.
[FR-NOT-001 in e-Stamp Duty Refund] Status SMS: The system shall send an SMS to the purchaser at submission, decision and credit.
[IR-004 in Online Building Plan Approval] SMS gateway: The system shall send SMS through the State SMS gateway with DLT-registered templates.
[FR-NOT-001 in Online Building Plan Approval] Submission SMS: The system shall send an SMS to the owner on submission with application number and due date.
[FR-NOT-003 in Online Building Plan Approval] Decision SMS: The system shall send an SMS to the owner on approval or rejection, including the rejection reason where applicable.
